door.reason: Bosch gives 104.9 cm deep with the door open at 90 degrees, which puts the door's hinge axis 28 mm behind the body front at the rim's left edge. So the back of the rim on the hinge side swings up to 3 cm behind the body front there (about 1 % of the door, at the hinge), hidden behind the rim and the side panel. The door's free edge comes forward all the way, and nothing else of it goes into the body.
door.source: Bosch manual 9001910910 (technical data, p. 13) and Bosch's WGA1420PIN page: 59.0 cm deep, 63.6 cm with the door closed, 104.9 cm with the door open at 90 degrees
